entries.label: Guadalajara — atelier du laboratoire R-02
entries.scene: The industrial SERVICE WORKSHOP section inside the hidden Guadalajara laboratory in MGR R-02, distinct from the already separate sewer tunnel. Preserve the laboratory maintenance-bay details shown in the screenshots: dark blue-grey steel floor and grating, a lower service pit behind a yellow safety rail, yellow painted cross-braced steel upright supports, angular cyan-grey equipment housings along the rear wall, thick service pipes, a raised yellow-railed catwalk with plain grey cargo crates and containers beneath. Cool dim industrial blue-green lighting with small neutral-white work lights. One level foreground metal walkway, reference service pit and machinery behind. Omit all people, bodies, biological specimens, robots, explosions and HUD. No unrelated science-fiction cylinders or invented operating theatre.
